Title: Azure CDN Standard Rules Engine preview update

Body.Content:
Earlier this summer, we launched Azure CDN Standard rules engine with ARM and PowerShell support for Azure CDN from Microsoft. Rules Engine allows you to control CDN behavior on a per HTTP request basis, to optimize your workloads based on your customer needs. This week we’re announcing that portal support is now available as part of this preview. You can now customize your Content Delivery Network behavior quickly and easily in just a few steps in the Azure Portal.

Learn more
